name: animated-graphics-lab
description: Local-first article visualization lab that turns agent-written AGL_GRAPHIC placeholders into animated GIF/MP4 article embeds.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/composition-schema && npm run build --workspace packages/workflow-core && npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/worker
scripts.db:local:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply animated_graphics_lab --local --persist-to .wrangler/state --config apps/worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.local:setup: npm run check:local && npm run setup:local && npm run db:local:migrate && npm run build && npm test -- --runInBand
scripts.local:setup:codex: npm run check:local -- --require-agent --agent=codex && npm run agl:codex:check && npm run setup:local -- --agent=codex && npm run db:local:migrate && npm run build && npm test -- --runInBand
scripts.local:setup:custom: npm run check:local -- --require-agent && npm run setup:local -- --agent=custom && npm run db:local:migrate && npm run build && npm test -- --runInBand
scripts.agl:run: npm run build --workspace @agl/workflow-core && node packages/local-runner/src/cli.mjs run
scripts.check:design-labels: npm run build --workspace packages/composition-schema && node scripts/check-design-labels.mjs

author: Animated Graphics Lab Contributors
